items.q: Does a guest need to download an app?
items.a: No — everything works straight from a mobile browser, with one simple link.

items.q: How do I add Voice Guestbook or Event Camera?
items.a: These are add-on modules we plan individually and activate after a consultation with our team.

items.q: When is the final price confirmed?
items.a: You'll see the invitation's price before it's published; for custom events, we put together a personal quote.

finalCta.lead: Start building your invitation now, or get in touch with us to plan a full digital experience.

about.heroTitle: LYST was built so an event isn't just organized — it's memorable.
about.quote: “Our mission is to turn getting ready for a celebration into something simple, enjoyable, and modern.”
about.missionBody: A traditional invitation is a single moment. We wanted to build something that covers the whole experience of an event — from the invite to the memory.

changes.text: Your invitation, event details, RSVPs and guest communication all live in one place — saving time and making everything easier to manage.
Guests get instant updates, the exact location, and can confirm attendance with a tap.
Every photo, video and voice message comes together in one place and stays there, permanently.

about.visionBody: We believe digital products should bring people closer together. Every feature in LYST is built to cut through the organizational chaos and give you more time to actually enjoy the celebration.

principles.title: Digital Craft
principles.text: We believe an invitation is the face of an event. That's why we give every detail of the design our full attention.

principles.title: Innovation & Function
principles.text: We combine the latest technology with a simple user experience, so you get maximum results for minimum effort.

principles.title: A Living Connection
principles.text: Digital invitation, RSVP, photos, video and voice messages — all in one space, connecting guests before, during and after the event.

about.ctaLead: Turn planning into an enjoyable adventure.

product.heroLead: LYST brings event planning, guest management, interaction and memory-keeping together in one place.
product.m1Title: Every detail of the event, on one link.
product.m1Text: Guests no longer have to dig through chats for the address, time, or dress code. Everything lives in one polished, responsive digital space that opens perfectly from any phone.
product.m2Title: Every guest's response and status, in one place.
product.m2Text: Confirming attendance takes one tap — no extra calls or messages. Guests can add plus-ones and share the details that matter to you.
product.m3Title: A simple control panel for the host.
product.m3Text: Keep track of your entire guest flow from one central panel. Export your data, group guests by table or status, and save time on the logistics.
product.m4Text: Turn your guests into co-creators of the event. With a one-time digital camera and voice messages recorded live, every emotion gets captured in real time.
product.m5Title: Everything created stays in one place, long after the event ends.
product.m5Text: Not a single photo or voice message gets lost. The moment your event ends, LYST automatically builds a digital archive that keeps those precious moments safe for years to come.
product.ctaLead: Create your digital invitation today and turn a simple gathering into an unforgettable experience.
